## Telegram AI bot, Lite

### How it works

This workflow turns Telegram messages into an AI-powered chat bot with lightweight conversation memory stored in n8n workflow data. It loads per-chat history, builds a provider-specific AI request, sends it to the configured model, returns the reply to Telegram, and then logs the turn for future context. If the AI request follows the alternate failure branch, it sends a fallback message saying it will come back to the user.

### Setup steps

- Configure Telegram credentials for the Telegram Trigger and Telegram send-message nodes.
- In the Settings node, set ai_provider, ai_model, ollama_url, and business_name for the desired assistant behavior.
- If using a hosted AI provider, configure the HTTP request authentication or headers required by that provider in the AI request-building logic and Ask the AI node.
- Activate the workflow so Telegram webhook updates can trigger it.

### Customization

Change the Settings node to switch AI providers or models, update the business_name/system context, or adjust the code nodes to change memory limits and prompt formatting.

## Receive and configure

Starts the bot from an incoming Telegram message and applies the workflow-level AI and business settings used downstream.

## Prepare AI request

Loads the current chat history from workflow data, assembles the prompt and request payload, and sends the HTTP request to the selected AI provider.

## Return and log answer

Parses the AI response, sends the generated answer back to the Telegram chat, and records the completed turn for future conversation context.

## Send fallback notice

Handles the lower branch from the AI request by notifying the Telegram user that the bot will return to them later.

nodes.name: Set AI Configuration
nodes.notes: Everything you change is here. Three fields matter: ai_model, business_name, knowledge.

assignments.name: knowledge
assignments.value:
- Put the facts your bot may state here, one per line.
- Anything not written here gets the cannot_answer_message instead.

assignments.name: cannot_answer_message
assignments.value: Thanks for your message. Someone will get back to you here shortly.

assignments.name: prompt
assignments.value:
You are the front line of {{BUSINESS}}'s customer chat. You answer what the business notes below cover, and
nothing else.

BUSINESS NOTES (the only facts you may state):
{{KNOWLEDGE}}

ANSWER IT YOURSELF whenever the business notes above contain the answer. Set answered to true and write the
reply.

A rule in the notes covers everything inside it, including things the notes never name. When the notes state
where you ship, what you accept, how long something takes, or what is included, then ANY question inside that
subject is already answered, even when the exact place, item or word the customer used does not appear in the
notes. Work it out from the rule and answer.

So: a question about shipping to a place the notes exclude is answered, and the answer is no. A question about a
delivery option the notes describe is answered. Saying "we do not do that" is answering, not guessing.

Only a subject the notes say NOTHING about is unanswerable. Read the notes again before deciding you cannot
answer: most of what a customer asks is already in them, one step of reasoning away.

SAY YOU CANNOT ANSWER only when one of these is true:
- the answer would need a fact that is genuinely not in the notes above, such as one customer's own order,
  stock of a specific item, or a price the notes do not give
- the customer asks for a person, an agent, a manager, or to talk to someone
- the customer is angry, upset, or complaining
- the message is about a refund, a cancellation, a complaint, damaged goods, or a payment problem

When you cannot answer, set answered to false and leave reply as an empty string. The seller's own sentence is
sent instead of yours, so do not write an apology, do not attempt a partial answer, and do not promise a time.

NEVER invent a fact. Prices, stock, policies, delivery times and order details come from the notes or from
nobody.

Reply with JSON only, no other text:
{"answered": true or false,
 "reason": "<short. If true: 'answered from notes'. If false: which of the four rules above stopped you.>",
 "reply": "<what to send the customer. One or two sentences. Empty string when answered is false.>"}

The conversation so far:
{{HISTORY}}

The customer's new message:
{{MESSAGE}}

nodes.name: Prepare Conversation Data
nodes.notes: Who wrote, what they said, and what was said before. No database needed.

nodes.name: Post to AI API
nodes.notes: One node for OpenAI, Anthropic or Ollama. If it errors, the red path still replies.

nodes.name: Parse AI Response
nodes.notes: If the AI cannot answer, your sentence is sent, never the model's guess.

nodes.name: Reply with AI Answer
nodes.notes: The bot answers what the notes cover.

nodes.name: Notify of Delayed Response
nodes.notes: The AI could not be reached. The customer still hears something.
